seo.title: App Foundry | Kain Product App Template
seo.description: A Kain web archetype for product apps, member workspaces, auth strategy, integrations, and typed local data collections.

hero.title: Build workspace-style websites without leaving the Kain pack.
hero.body: App Foundry is the universal pack's product-app lane: app modules, auth strategies, data collections, prompts, and actor routes stay manifest-driven and Rust-free for the end user.

feature_cards.title: React-like shell metadata
feature_cards.body: App Foundry emits a UI schema that keeps module layout and form contracts inspectable.

feature_cards.title: Auth stays data-driven
feature_cards.body: Passwordless, invite, and SSO strategy surfaces live in manifest data.

feature_cards.title: Routes stay actor-ready
feature_cards.body: Workspace routes, app metadata, and setup forms are available over local APIs.
